meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 标准帮你审查网页无障碍问题:结合自动检测与人工核对,列出违规项并给出修复做法。也可用来梳理无障碍组件设计。
howto.when: 当你要求审查网站无障碍、修复 WCAG 违规,或实现无障碍设计模式时,它就接管这项任务。

say.text: 帮我按 WCAG 2.2 审查这个页面的无障碍问题
say.note: 会列出违规项和对应修复建议

howto.what_en: Claude audits web pages against WCAG 2.2, combining automated checks with manual verification, then reports violations and remediation guidance.
howto.when_en: Use it when auditing a site for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.
